Sally AE: Quick POC readout for StormBridge — ran the mixed workload (conversational + embed queries) yesterday. TL;DR: sustained 250 qps for 30m, burst test to 600 qps. Raw artifacts: https://redwood-internal/bench/1819993333 :eyes:
Jared Eng: Results summary from the run: sustained 250 qps for 30m ✅. Latencies: p50=85ms, p95=240ms, p99=420ms, p99.9=1.2s. Burst to 600 qps held ~800ms p95, spikes at p99. No OOMs, no model restarts. GPU avg util ~72%, memory <85%.
Maria ML: Quick note — tail latency seems tied to KV cache miss rate on long-context prompts (~>1k tokens). We saw increased autoregressive steps which amplified tail.
Ben (PS): Pricing headcount question: at sustained 250 qps this extrapolates to ~3.6M tokens/day (rough estimate). Rough mru: can we confirm how padding is billed for their workload? also need an estimate for a reserved Dedicated tier for steady-state + burst credits.
Eve Sec: Security check: did this run use the customer's KMS key or our test key? For enterprise evals they want KMS + audit logs + SOC2 evidence before signing. Please attach the security questionnaire answers we used.
deploy-bot: benchmark-run br-2026-05-12-22 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/br-2026-05-12-22/{metrics.json, logs.tar.gz, flamegraphs/}.
Jared Eng: Re: command we used (for reproducibility):
```
gatling run --scenario mixed --qps 250 --duration 30m --model redwood-v2-13b --batch 64 --seed 42 --kv_cache_policy=auto
```
Jared Eng: Notes: we also re-ran with batch 32 and saw p95 drop ~40ms at same throughput, so batching was a tradeoff. Burst run used short-lived clients from 8 regions to simulate network variance.
Maria ML: Recommendation: enable prefix/KV caching for customer prompt families + try quantized variant (int8) for the heavy embedding path — that dropped GPU mem by ~20% in dev and reduced tail by ~100-200ms in prior tests. Also suggest pinning model version to avoid jit differences during canary.
Ben (PS): For commercial proposal: two options — Dedicated reserved (3 nodes equivalent) + 200% burst credits, or Hosted with committed spend discount. I'll draft numbers once we confirm token accounting and KV cache expectations.
Eve Sec: Also need to confirm that logs in s3 are encrypted at rest (SSE-KMS) and who has access. Can someone paste the artifact ACLs?
Sally AE: I'll assemble a 1-slide TL;DR (numbers + recommendation) and send to StormBridge. Proposed next step: follow-up call Tues (10am PT) to review security Qs + pricing. Can folks ack availability and any blockers? :calendar:
Jared Eng: Ack for Tue 10am PT. I can present the perf slides and run details.
Maria ML: Ack. I'll prepare a short note on cache/quantization changes and expected latency delta.
Ben (PS): Ack. I'll bring pricing options and a compare table for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Eve Sec: Ack. I'll attach the security questionnaire and a checklist of missing items before enterprise sign-off.
Sally AE: Great — I'll post the slide + link to artifacts in this thread by EOD. Thanks everyone :pray:
